question: Who among the following flight lieutenants is the first woman pilot of the IAF to qualify to undertake combat missions on a fighter jet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhawana Kanth**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhawana Kanth** is the first woman pilot of the Indian Air Force (IAF) to qualify to undertake combat missions on a fighter jet.
 
• She was inducted into the IAF fighter squadron in June 2016.
 
• Bhawana Kanth, along with two other female pilots, Avani Chaturvedi and Mohana Singh, were the first women to be commissioned as flying officers in the IAF fighter stream.
 
• She flew solo on a MiG-21 Bison in March 2018, a significant milestone in her career.
 
• This marked a historic moment for the Indian Air Force and for women in the armed forces in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The induction of women into the fighter stream of the Indian Air Force is a part of the broader initiative to increase the role of women in the Indian armed forces.
 
• Women were first allowed to join the Indian Air Force as short-service commissioned officers in 1992.
 
• In 2015, the Indian government approved the induction of women into the fighter stream, marking a significant step towards gender equality in the armed forces.
 
• Bhawana Kanth's achievement is a testament to the evolving opportunities for women in the Indian military.
 
• The Indian Air Force continues to encourage and support women in various roles, including combat positions.
